memory_items.title: extract objects
memory_items.description: A PS concept of kind routine/intermediate for ARC-style grid reasoning.
memory_items.content:
# extract objects

Kind: routine/intermediate.

Parameters:
- input grid (grid): grid (or region of a grid) to extract objects from
- single color (bool): if True, only extract objects of a single color
- connectivity (str): object connectedness (4-way, 8-way, or none). None admits non-contiguous objects.
- background color (str): the background color to ignore when extracting objects. Default value is 0 or black.
- criteria (selection criteria := Callable[[object], bool]): filter extracted objects to those satisfying the criteria (e.g., being inside a container)

- direction (direction := Literal["up", "down", "left", "right", "up-right", "up-left", "down-right", "down-left"]): the direction to draw the line in (up, down, left, or right)
